body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles). Parent: #1202; original milestone 2, source-only research. Maximum two focused PRs.

Investigate the complete ten-component Angola–DRC family `gap-source-batch:80eb2e392d5ef4fe3781d37a`, with all five contact subjects below. Completed source comparisons contain two unique compatible source subjects and eight mixed/partial cases; all ten stay in scope. No numerical consistency unknown was found in this family. This does not prove dry land, water, legal authority, original processing cause or repair permission. Highest individually unique measured priority is6456 (13,121,388.97368118m²); the family minimum615 belongs to a mixed case and must not be represented as that unique witness.

Coordination: #462 initial broader DRC review is CLOSED; #411 initial Angola review, #878 DRC city/territory/code crosswalk and #1046 Angola2018-to2024 DPA crosswalk are OPEN/blocked. Preserve their scopes and original evidence. This work concerns exact gap coverage/source/water comparison, not current administrative role or DPA/code adjudication. No duplicate exact-family work item was found in the current whole GitHub search.

Original-source research can proceed independently of reusable custody PR #1240: retrieve or reuse the exact consumed original COD simplified product at the immutable upstream URL below and reauthenticate its whole3,294,607bytes/SHA before use; the AGO original is already retained in the actual merged six-part semantic archive with member/whole pins below. Root independently authenticated both complete originals. Pending PR #1240 is a reuse convenience, not a scientific dependency or a merged product. The assigned worker must preserve authenticated originals in its own ordinary source evidence, retain actual retrieval observations and follow the existing read-only readiness/claim protocol. Root independently read all ten full ordinary component features from seven merged payload files and all five complete contact features from two baseline files.

Acceptance:
- Authenticate all ten full component geometries/fragments and five contacts, including point/zero-area contacts, original water diagnostics and actual native lineage. Preserve original, successor and current assessment vintages distinctly. Do not select only the two unique source witnesses or one representative point.
- Compare the complete consumed COD and AGO simplified source products and every necessary neighboring feature. Retain complete intersection/difference/union pointsets, positive and zero contacts, missing areas and uncertainty. Distinguish separately advertised full product URLs from the bytes actually consumed. No snapping, buffering, simplification, MakeValid, coordinate normalization or nearest fill.
- Evaluate independent physical-water and appropriate authoritative river/lake/border references with dates, registration, resolution and complete extent. Empty archived water-reference lists mean missing evidence, not land; administrative overlap alone does not establish dry land.
- Classify each entire component and its uncertain portions: supported source mismatch, authenticated processing loss, supported water, mixed evidence or unresolved. Identify an executed processing stage only with original input/execution closure; current recipes without that closure are hypotheses.
- Deliver a coordinated engineering proposal only for supported defects, covering all affected neighbors, original pointsets, stable IDs/history and before/after native/geography/release/crosswalk/content/prevention checks. Later repair must use the explicit prepared v7 successor chain; research does not authorize geometry or ownership changes. Unsupported candidates stay in the global unresolved backlog.
- Use ordinary versioned evidence, substantive positive/negative controls and two actual final producer executions as required by the existing repository policy, independent exact-head review including current issue/PR bindings, serialized integration and actual merged-byte readback. Preserve failed attempts and unique evidence; release only your own managed checkout. No provider, production database, deployment or publisher action.

Baseline: `79ffb2ed04702e16f009e4675a8d74ef9bd09d4f`. Original source/recipe metadata: `cea80a8aa1f8a55ccb448a8f2ff71e10c49a26f1`. Current-successor inventory #1215 is merged; a26 PR #1231 assessment has accepted review but is pending merge. Never silently replace an original geometry with a successor or call an unmerged assessment delivered.
